If you are thinking about starting doing yoga, but you don’t have enough time/motivation/possibility/money to go to studio, this app will definitely work for you. Moreover, sometimes it’s even better than a studio! It’s so well done - the voiceover person says just enough and is just encouraging enough without being an over the top “online fitness coach” type. The videos are simple and easy to follow, but the voice is also enough to guide you through the movements without having to look at the screen. There are several playlists and they are really well composed, it’s modern music that fits my taste and is not distracting (I hate for example songs with lyrics as it’s extremely distracting and some other apps didn’t pay attention to that detail). The flexibility to choose between a ton of different time lengths, types of practice and levels is amazing and in contrast to some “compose your own class” apps (usually these sequences turn out to be a bit... weird ) they are well thought and flows match the descriptions perfectly.

Really, really great and I’ve done a lot of online workouts .. this is the closest thing to an actual yoga class that I’ve found. Btw I love the latest update. User experience is much better than before. New classes are better than previous ones. New teachers seem really experienced.

The latest update is absolutely awesome.... Recently I’m in a place without any yoga community so I tried out several yoga apps. This one is simple and elegant, and with a focus on improving your practice. Never boring and easy to grow your skill. I feel it’s really aimed at people who really want to practice yoga as an integral part of wellness, instead of just another type of superficial workout. The guiding voice is so soothing and I keep it on to take advantage of the timely reminders to self-correct. 
The videos are good quality and show the transitions between the poses clearly. And, required for me, you can download sequences to use offline. It is not overwhelming with unnecessary bells and whistles. The app is a delight for beginners as well and is a great introduction (or re-introduction) for those who may not have recently been on the mat. The latest update made the app even clearer and easier to use. I think that videos with different teachers, in different places brought a wind freshness. The one thing I could recommend may be adding some outdoor sessions. 
But overall, this has been the first yoga app I have stuck with since I’m not able to participate in regular yoga classes. Thank you!

Love at first use. This yoga app is literally perfect - basically allows you to adjust to your preference every factor of the practice that can vary from studio to studio and class to class (difficulty, pace, level of instruction and specific area of stretch/strength focus). The instructions are clear at any level, video and voiceovers are great quality. If you’re a bit lost and don’t know which classes are for you, you can sign up for a program that will guide you. 
And my favorite part is that I can play my own music from other apps simultaneous to the instruction, as that is often what makes or breaks my enjoyment of a studio yoga class. I love this thoughtful and thorough app and have recommended it to all my friends. Thank you, Lotus Yoga, for brightening up my days.

Great update. I’m into yoga for quite a while, but because of household and family duties I neglected regular workouts... I came across Lotus yoga a few months ago and I remembered how wonderful it is to relax by stretching and breathing. The app was recently updated and now I love it even more. There is a separate category for women, including mom classes, which is just perfect. The recent events and lockdown was a stressful time for everybody, so I thought: Why not to do yoga with my family? I started doing beginner classes with them and I must say, it’s so much fun. Some poses are really challenging, I wouldn’t suspect! Workouts aren’t boring or monotonous, even my 9 yo son enjoys them. The app keeps us motivated as I assign classes to particular days and hours, so there’s no excuse. I think it’s user friendly, everything is clearly categorized and I don’t have problem with finding what I need. Whatever it sounds, this app really has changed our lives. We could stay active while staying at home and keep calm, which is extremely important now.

reviews.text:
Bait and Switch. I just bought this app at the beginning of April (the yoga studio I was using closed mid-march because of coronavirus) and paid $70 for the lifetime membership after 2 or 3 free trial workouts. I used this app 5 days a week on my lunch and loved every bit of it.

Well now they have a “massive update” and all of the old routines are gone. The pleasant voice and clean illustrations, gone. The ability to customize routines (typically I like to lengthen poses as some of them feel rushed, or add/remove reps etc) is gone.

My already-favorite routines I cannot find anywhere, I think they are gone for good. The new routines are super basic videos, you can get better content from YT. The models are ugly, one man even has a beard lol, and the pristine white room is gone, replaced by beige and grey walls. This is important to me as I do not wear glasses when practicing so the white background and bright colored clothes of the model (I think it may have been an illustration? Not sure) helped a lot. I did one of the ‘new’ routines today and learned the voice guidance misses important instruction, obviously I am not expected to stare at the screen the whole time. I was instructed to lay on my back so I did... when I looked up at my ipad the model was in a bridge pose but the voice never instructed that.

The new routines are... definitely not for me, lol. New routines are cataloged as “for women” or “better than coffee” or “toned booty” and most are only 10 or 15 minutes long. While the old app had “fat burner” routines or “for runner” routines (one of my favorites as I also run every morning), they were also 45 minutes or longer. For the price I expect much better content and an app that would be useable for years and years to come, not having all of the routines removed after less than a month and replaced with cheesy videos.

I have reached out to support to ask if there is any way to get the old, good, version of the poses back. With no response, I’ve already asked apple for a refund and downloaded pocket yoga to replace this one. It also lacks customization (has separate builder app that I’ll probably check out later) but a good community around it and, it was $3 instead of $70.
What were you thinking? You had a fantastic app and now it’s...not!. Please give me back my custom plans and previous pre-made classes. I’m now off my plan and am aching over!

Speaking of visual cues, the model in the video did the most advanced version of each pose, and no modification options were given. If a true beginner were to watch this video, injury would be likely unless they are young, healthy and already pretty physically fit. 

Yes, of course there are limitations to offering yoga classes in this format, and I’m sure the app developers have some kind of disclaimer somewhere in the app saying to use this at your own risk, etc etc, but in my opinion it really doesn’t absolve them of the responsibility of doing a better job to prevent injury. Something that I really enjoyed and found to be unique about this app is the way that the classes break down each pose. When you open a class on Lotus Yoga, before you hit play you can scroll down the list to see not only which poses will be worked on, but for how long. This is perfect for days when you want a great ab workout or days when you want to avoid doing planks entirely! To me, nothing is worse than thinking you’re going to love a yoga class only to find it’s filled with poses you aren’t too crazy about, and this app eliminates that problem entirely. There’s also a section of this app called Poses, where you can search each individual yoga post and read instructions on how to do the pose correctly, as well as the benefits and important warnings about the pose. Once I started looking into the poses on this app, I searched for almost an hour reading up on different poses ! It was so awesome. You can also sync this app with your calendar to to schedule your classes! Great for the organized yogi. TONS OF OPTIONS. One of the most outstanding features of this app is its the provision of lots of options. I have installed many yoga apps on my system but this particular app seems to be leagues away from them. The various video classes with live tutors and programs this app provides are fascinating. It works so well in providing motion picture (videos) as well as normal pictures showing instructors and instructions. Although some of the video qualities provided by the app are a tad bit choppy, the quality of content it provides and the professionalism of instructors in the videos are enough to actually make the choppiness in the video quality less noticeable. However, it would become more interesting and engaging if new yoga routines like the Ashtanga are explored from time to time. I'm greatly impressed at the consistency with which new trends, features, and updates are added to the app. This yoga app also provides bonus features like steaks and community practice for its users. ABSOLUTELY RECOMMENDED!!!
